name: ARK: Survival Ascended
tagline: Native connector for ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated servers: one AsaApi plugin inside ArkAscendedServer.exe that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: ARK: Survival Ascended Windows dedicated server (Steam app 2430930) build named in the release
File access to the server's ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64 folder and to its start command
RCONEnabled=True in GameUserSettings.ini for console commands and shutdown

assets.label: Server plugin (AsaApi included)
assets.requires: ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated server on Windows
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64, copy ArkApi\Plugins\TakaroAsa\TakaroConfig.txt.example to TakaroConfig.txt, paste the registration token and start the server with AsaApiLoader.exe.
